messages.content: I want to plan a trip to Japan for two weeks in April.
Great choice. Do you have a budget in mind?
Only spend up to $4000 total, and exclude Tokyo -- I've already been there twice.
Understood. I will exclude Tokyo and keep the budget under $4000.
I prefer smaller towns and nature over big cities.
Agreed, I will prioritize smaller towns and nature spots rather than major cities.
The research shows that early April has the best cherry blossoms in the Kansai region.
That's a great data point. I'll build the itinerary around Kansai in early April.
Please prepare a day-by-day itinerary once the flights are booked.
I will prepare the itinerary once flights are confirmed.
